title: ELEVATE
description: Ride a cinematic luxury elevator through architectural stops, holding doors and meeting passengers as the tower's story unfolds.

prompt.objective: Build a cinematic elevator journey that reveals an architectural tower and its residents one stop at a time.

mintAssets.brief: A luxury elevator, tower spaces, furnished floor dioramas, and a varied passenger cast.

experience: Travel through staged elevator stops with synchronized doors, camera movement, and narrative overlays.
Let visitors hold the doors while passengers enter, ride, and leave at their destinations.
prompt.visualDirection: Editorial archviz with brushed metal, warm interiors, restrained typography, and deliberate cinematic pacing.
